steps: Meet eligibility: registered voter in Charleston County or an adjoining county (or aged 16-17).
Apply as a poll manager to the Charleston County Board of Elections & Voter Registration.
Attend the Poll Manager Training Session (3-4 hours) and pass the online certification test.
Work the entire Election Day (6:00 AM-approximately 7:30 PM).
Receive $135 ($60 training + $75 Election Day); pay processed in ~30 business days.
timing: Election Day 6:00 AM-7:30 PM (13.5 hours) plus 3-4 hour training session and online certification test.
weasel_words: The online certification test is required but its duration is not stated, so no test time is counted.
Training pay ($60) is only released if you work Election Day.
The county's separate 2026 recruitment flyer advertises 'earn up to $250' for the 2026 season; this route uses the exact per-election $135 figure from the official application.
